paragraphs: PublicInput sells a platform for running community engagement projects, public meetings, and resident communications from one system. The engagement product is described as a central hub for surveys, comment submissions, documents, and meetings. Engagement features named on that page include AI Comment Analysis, Equity Mapping, and Omni-channel Comment Collection.

A second product line, PublicInput Meetings, covers the meeting lifecycle for government clerks. The page lists a drag-and-drop agenda builder with templates and versioned packets, a single public meeting page, and hybrid integration with Zoom and Microsoft Teams. Minutes are drafted automatically from votes, motions, and public comments, and audit-ready PDFs, meeting packets, and CSV records can be exported in one click. Compliance material on that page cites state open meetings law requirements including the Brown Act and the Indiana Open Door Law.

The company describes itself as community engagement software that helps state and local government agencies. The same page lists Local Government, Transit Agencies, DOTs & MPOs, Consultants, and Councils of Government as groups served. PublicInput is software-as-a-service, and the engagement page lists ISO 27001 / 27018 / NIST 800 Series Alignment among the standards it says it meets.

quote.text: PublicInput was started with the goal of giving the average citizen a voice, on their schedule.
